predictions.claim: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces factual hallucinations by 42% in human evaluations on open-domain question answering benchmarks.
Sentence-level evaluation overestimates factual precision by 14.6 percentage points compared to atomic claim verification in FActScore.
Lexical BM25 retrieval alone captures 100% of multi-hop rationale spans on the SciFact scientific claim dataset.
Injecting topically similar but factually irrelevant passages into RAG prompts increases unfaithful synthesis claims from 8.1% to 27.4%.
Combining GraphRAG personalized random walks with dense search and BM25 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion raises multi-hop recall at k=8 from 71.2% to 88.6%.
Mechanical substring and fuzzy quote alignment eliminates 94.2% of hallucinated evidence attributions in scientific agents.
For compute-optimal transformer training, model parameters should be quadrupled while keeping training tokens constant.
Chinchilla (70B parameters, 1.4 trillion tokens) significantly outperforms Gopher (280B) and GPT-3 (175B) on downstream evaluation benchmarks.
AlphaFold achieved a median backbone accuracy of 0.96 angstrom r.m.s.d.95 in CASP14.
AlphaFold structure predictions maintain peak accuracy even when multiple sequence alignment depth drops below 5 homologous sequences.
Prime editing mediates all 12 possible base-to-base DNA conversions without requiring double-strand breaks and yields off-target indel rates below 0.5%.
FlashAttention uses tiling between GPU HBM and on-chip SRAM to train GPT-2 3.0x faster than standard PyTorch without approximation.
Mistral 7B uses a sliding window attention size of 4,096 tokens and outperforms Llama 2 13B across reasoning and code benchmarks.
Retrieval-augmented generation reduces energy consumption in sovereign quantum datacenter cryostats by 73%.
Prime editing completely cures autosomal dominant Huntington's disease in Phase III human clinical trials with zero adverse events.
